title: Pipeline
description: Steps that run one after another when the pipeline is triggered.

name.description: The pipeline's name: lower-case letters, digits and dashes.

trigger.description: When the pipeline runs, besides when the user starts it.

schedule.description: A cron expression: minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week.

onChange.description: Whether the pipeline also runs when one of its files changes.

steps.description: The steps, in the order they run.

name.description: The step's name, which the pipeline's log shows.

when.description: Which outcome of the steps before lets this one run.

retries.description: How often the step runs again after it fails.
